description: At the iteration ceiling with partial results. The right decision is to return what exists; starting new work guarantees the run is killed mid-flight. Runs at toolChoice 'none' (added 2026-09-12): the framework forces 'none' on the final permitted iteration in production, so a native cell measured at 'auto' here was measuring a turn production never produces (results §14.3.4).
